subject: Migrate zipmap unit test to new framework (#474)
reason: The change is a pure test-infrastructure migration: it removes the zipmap entry from the legacy serverTests[] table in server.c and adds an equivalent standalone unit test file (src/unit/test_zipmap.c) registered in test_files.h. No server runtime behaviour, command, reply, data structure, replication or persistence code is modified, so there is no reachable behaviour change for a fuzzer scenario to exercise.
